summary: Studio City Company, wholly-owned subsidiary of Studio City International Holdings Ltd, announced a proposed offering of new senior secured notes and a concurrent tender offer for any and all of its outstanding 7.00% senior secured notes due 2027. Terms (interest rate, price) to be determined at pricing. Proceeds from the new notes offering, plus cash on hand, will be used to repurchase the 2027 notes via the tender offer, with any remaining notes to be redeemed. The new notes are secured obligations ranking equally with existing senior debt but subordinated to a US$30 million credit facility secured by common collateral. No board recommendation or advisor named. Completion subject to market conditions. This is a liability management transaction (refinancing/tender) rather than a regulatory special situation; no premium stated until pricing. Watch for pricing spreads and take-up rate in the tender offer.
